reviews.author: Christian Tamburri
reviews.text:
Been dealing with being favored by mosquitos my entire life!!  Enough is enough!!

Finally decided to do what I should have done long ago- trap and kill them WITHOUT harmful pesticides.

This is exactly what Greengaurd is doing!

Really happy with the results just after 3 nights of mosquito trapping.
The equipment is safe, non invasive, and most importantly; it works really well!

Bruce delivered and set up one system for my home.
It’s really convenient to have the team, dedicated to customer service; deliver and set up the system.

The trap is so effective, I am adding an additional unit to the large yard since it backs up to the greenbelt where those bloodsuckers thrive.
Not thriving off of my blood anymore!
It’s really nice having a backyard space without hundreds of bites per hour.

Also considering adding 2 units to my work place.
Did I mention, I HATE mosquitos?

Thank you Greengaurd for protecting families; keeping them safe from the horrors I have lived through.

Check out how many I captured in 6 nights with the Greengaurd system!
Must have been 100+ buzzing around in there which were captured in one night.
They dehydrate and die within a day or so which makes it fun to check the death toll each morning😆

reviews.author: Brian Mueller
reviews.text: Installed 2 Mosquitaire traps, 1 with CO2 & 1 without, 6 weeks ago in my landscaped backyard in central TX during a relatively rainy Spring. 80% decrease in mosquitos in 2 weeks; 95+% decrease now. We can enjoy our patio comfortably without burning mosquito coils! Couldn't be happier with the product and GreenGuard team. Highly recommend both to anyone frustrated with outdoor living/entertaining during warmer months.

reviews.author: BJ Derganc
reviews.text: Bruce was very knowledgeable. I have owned the Biogents trap for several years now and learned quite a few new things on the first visit.

reviews.author: Oleg Zhoglo
reviews.text: I’ve been using greenguard for mosquito control for over a year now, the service has made a huge difference, we can use our yard again.  The best part is that it is safe, doesn’t harm other valuable insects and it is convenient.   Highly recommended! Service and the people are great too.

reviews.author: David Allison
reviews.text: GreenGuard has changed my life.  GreenGuard has turned my back yard into the sanctuary that I have always wanted.  They maintain our mosquito traps on a monthly basis and the result is that my family is able to fully use the backyard anytime of year, anytime of day.  Effective mosquito control is not a myth.  With the right traps and the right maintenance plan, mosquitos can be completely controlled.

manual.author: Sarah M.
manual.text: We used to eat dinner inside all summer. Now our patio is the most-used room in the house. No pesticides around our kids, that peace of mind is priceless.

manual.author: David K.
manual.text: The rental program is worth every penny. They handle everything, I didn't even notice when they swapped the tank. My yard is just always protected.

manual.author: Linda R.
manual.text: I garden constantly and was terrified of sprays hurting my bees. GreenGuard USA was the only option I trusted. Bees are thriving, mosquitoes are gone.

manual.author: Marcus T.
manual.text: I was skeptical. I've tried sprays, citronella candles, everything. Within 10 days of the rental trap going in, I stopped getting bitten on my patio entirely. It genuinely works.

manual.author: Jennifer L.
manual.text: The rental program was perfect for us. We didn't want to spend thousands upfront. GreenGuard handles everything, the CO₂ shows up every month, and my kids play outside again all summer.
